documents.text: ### Processor A part of a plugin that extracts JavaScript code from other kinds of files, then lets ESLint lint the JavaScript code. For example, [`@eslint/markdown`](https://github.com/eslint/markdown) includes a processor that converts the text of ``` code blocks in Markdown files into code that can be linted. For more information on configuring processors, see [Plugins > Specify a Processor](../configure/plugins#specify-a-processor).

## Custom Processors

An ESLint processor extracts JavaScript code from other kinds of files, then lets ESLint lint the JavaScript code. Alternatively, you can use a processor to manipulate JavaScript code before parsing it with ESLint.

For example, [@eslint/markdown](https://github.com/eslint/markdown) contains a custom processor that lets you lint JavaScript code inside of Markdown code blocks.

request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
